price_disclaimer: Prices and calories are approximate, are provided as a guide only, and may vary by location and portion. Entree prices are for the steak or dish alone; sides may be extra. Last updated October 2026.
intro: LongHorn Steakhouse is the casual Western-themed steakhouse known for its grill-marked steaks hand-seasoned and fire-grilled to order: the Renegade Sirloin, the tender Flo's Filet, and the 20-ounce Outlaw Ribeye. Beyond steak there is Parmesan Crusted Chicken, grilled salmon, baby back ribs, loaded appetizers like the Texas Tonion, and the famous Chocolate Stampede dessert. Below is the full LongHorn Steakhouse menu with prices and calories for 2026.
quick_answer: A 6 oz Renegade Sirloin at LongHorn is about $15.99, a Flo's Filet is $26.99, and the 20 oz Outlaw Ribeye is $33.99. Parmesan Crusted Chicken is about $17.99, salmon $19.79, and appetizers run $9 to $14. Steaks come fire-grilled to order. A 7 oz Renegade Sirloin is about 340 calories.

highlights.label: steaks seasoned and grilled to order

hot_deal: LongHorn value: the Renegade Sirloin (from about $15.99) is the best-value steak, and lunch sizes run cheaper. The eClub and app drop a free appetizer or dessert and birthday rewards, and the steak-and-side combos make a full meal. Steaks are the draw, so the sirloin plus a loaded baked potato is the classic order. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: How much is a steak at LongHorn Steakhouse?
faqs.a: A 6 oz Renegade Sirloin is about $15.99, the tender Flo's Filet is $26.99, and the 20 oz Outlaw Ribeye is $33.99. Lunch sizes run cheaper. Entree prices are for the steak; some come with a side, others add a few dollars.
Flo's Filet is LongHorn's signature filet mignon, named after a company figure. It is the most tender steak on the menu, hand-cut and fire-grilled, about $26.99 for a 6 oz and $31.99 for a 9 oz.

The Chocolate Stampede is LongHorn's famous dessert: a towering stack of chocolate cake, mousse and sauces with ice cream, big enough to share. It is about $10.99 and the signature way to finish a meal.

faqs.q: How many calories are in a LongHorn steak?
faqs.a: A 7 oz Renegade Sirloin is about 340 calories and a Flo's Filet about 520, while the 20 oz Outlaw Ribeye is around 1,570. Parmesan Crusted Chicken is about 900, and the Texas Tonion appetizer is around 1,560 for the whole thing.
